question: What makes the power-clan maya-free, and who trembles taking?
premises: without doubt, from taking, power-clan, maya-abandoned he may become
the initiate in recitations and the rest
inference: Doubtless taking joins the maya-free power-clan; trembling marks the reciter.
plain_english: Without doubt, from taking, power-clan, maya-abandoned he may become — trembling in taking may be the initiate in recitations and the rest.
